parameters.url: =http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={{ encodeURIComponent('cat:cs.LG AND (' + ($('Load Config').first().json.keywordQuery || '').split(/\s+OR\s+/i).map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(t => 'abs:"' + t + '"').join(' OR ') + ')') }}&start=0&max_results=40&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending

parameters.query: SELECT $1 AS dedup_key, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM papers WHERE dedup_key = $1) AS already_seen;
